checkpoint.warning: Unvalidated synthetic research policy; do not use for clinical decisions or surgery.

metadata.demonstration_initialization: Mean observed discounted return for each visited state/action; zero otherwise

environment_description.scripted_controller_development: Proportional exposure feedback with observed strain/force guards; engineering-tuned on development seeds 0–19. Not tuned on the final evaluation cohort.
environment_description.action_semantics: XY velocities at 10 mm/s maximum. Positive grip sets closure; grip < -0.2 releases; zero holds closure. Positive cautery power activates heat for this step; zero turns heat off. Handoff >0.5 ends the episode without implying recovery.
environment_description.objective: Hold the illustrative exposure target for the configured consecutive steps with damage below 0.15, critical damage below 0.08, force/strain within the selected modeling limits, cautery off and all tissue at or below 43 Celsius.
assumptions: Educational/research analytic surrogate, not a validated patient or clinical tool. Not SOFA/FEM.
Illustrative planar spring network and Gaussian heat source; no anatomical reconstruction, cutting/removal, fluid dynamics or inflammatory response.
Injury, temperatures, doses, force/strain thresholds, flow rates and vital-sign equations are illustrative and not clinically calibrated.
Bleeding, bile leakage and thermal damage are simplified governed states. Grasp and cautery contact occur in the modeled plane without tool depth.
Full simulated tissue state is observable for Markov RL. This is more information than a real robot or surgeon observes.
Injury lowers stiffness irreversibly. Heat dissipates but accumulated thermal damage does not heal during an episode.
Exposure is a synthetic marker opening obscured by accumulated simulated blood/bile, not clinical critical view of safety.
Success rewards simulated exposure only when modeled force/strain and injury conditions hold; handoff is a decision, not a simulated successful rescue.

metadata.observation_encoding: Reactive partial-state bins, not a Markov state representation
metadata.evaluation: Per-run held-out seeds are not used for fitting; reused engineering cohorts remain development data.
limitations: Illustrative synthetic dynamics without clinical validation.
Reactive bins alias distinct anatomy and deformation histories.
A discrete primitive wrapper restricts continuous tool controls.
Demonstration initialization/replay is additional assistance when enabled.
Confidence intervals exclude tissue-model and training-seed uncertainty.

provenance.selection_rule: Among completed runs choose maximum validation success rate; tie-break lower severe-harm rate, then lower mean maxdamage, then higher meanreturn. Retain every run, including failures. Parent reserved final cohort is excluded from selection.
provenance.scientific_note: Selected using exploratory synthetic validation; unvalidated research policy with no clinical competence claim. No reserved final patient cohort was used for selection.
